pr_title: changefeedccl: allow sarama compression options for kafka sink
pr_body:
Previously, the kafka sink would emit uncompressed data to kafka. This change updates the kafka sink to accept a "Compression" field in the `kafka_sink_config`, which gets passed to Sarama.

Release note (enterprise change): For kafka sinks, you can now add the optional JSON field "Compression" to the `kafka_sink_config` option. This field can be set to "none" (default), "gzip", "snappy", "lz4", or "zstd". Setting this field will result in the specified compression protocol to be used when emitting events.

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/89580
Epic: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/90270)

issue_context.title: changefeedccl: support Sarama (Kafka) compression options
issue_context.body:
Sarama [supports](https://github.com/Shopify/sarama/blob/03a43f93cd29dc549e6d9b11892795c206f9c38c/config.go#L118) compression [options](https://github.com/Shopify/sarama/blob/03a43f93cd29dc549e6d9b11892795c206f9c38c/message.go#L14-L20) including gzip, zstd and Snappy. Changefeeds should support them as well. This is important to minimize transfer costs for users.

I think we can use the existing `WITH compression='gzip’` syntax, no? So the scope here is to:

- Pass through the option to the Kafka sink
- Some validation on, um, valid values

I’ll put in my 2¢ that we can get this into v22.2.0. If we think that’s too aggressive, given our current point in the dev cycle, then v22.2.1. 

Tangent: if we support a compression option, it should work with all sinks unless there is some logical reason one shouldn’t or can’t. So while we are in the neighborhood here, do we not support gzip and zstd in any sinks? Webhooks, PubSub?

Jira issue: CRDB-20316

Epic CRDB-24463
